# facetious

> Joking, humorous, esp. inappropriately; not serious, concerned with frivolous things

> treating serious issues with inappropriate humor


## Example

- *Facetious behavior will not be tolerated during sex eduation class; it's time for all of you to treat these matters like mature adults.*
